decisions.title: A component file is named for the component in it
decisions.why: the coupling is what lets a reader find a symbol from a path, and an agent write one without asking

alternatives.option: a folder per component with an `index.tsx`
alternatives.why_not: every editor tab reads `index.tsx` and the path is the only thing that says which

decisions.title: The server/client boundary is declared, not inferred
decisions.why: a client component ships to the browser; what it imports ships with it

alternatives.option: infer the side from the folder
alternatives.why_not: a folder cannot say it, and React reads the directive rather than the path

decisions.title: Hooks are called where hooks live
decisions.why: the Rules of Hooks are about call order, and a hook called from a plain helper is a call order nobody can read. The rule keeps the half that is a fact about where a name is used; conditional and looped calls are the other half and no scope holds them

alternatives.why_not: it checks the call lexically and knows nothing about which folder is allowed to hold a hook

rules.why: `user-card.tsx` exports `UserCard`. Barrels are exempt by construction.
a component with no test is a component nobody has rendered outside the app
a client component runs in the browser; a database client or a secret there is in the bundle
a hook called from a plain helper is the bug the Rules of Hooks exist to prevent
